specs.Compatible Devices: Airplane Audio System, Amplifier, Car Stereo System, Desktop, Speaker, Television
specs.Compatibility Options: TVs, desktops, speakers, amplifiers, car stereos, and other AUX-compatible devices

features: Advanced Bluetooth 5.4 Technology: Equipped with Bluetooth version 5.4, this adapter ensures a steady and fast wireless connection with a range of up to 10 meters in open spaces. Whether you're transmitting or receiving, expect lag-free, high-fidelity sound every time.

Dual Mode Flexibility: The dongle supports dual Bluetooth pairing in Receiver (RX) mode only, allowing it to connect with two Bluetooth devices simultaneously. After pairing the first device, turn off its Bluetooth and repeat the process with the second. Once both are paired, you can switch between them seamlessly for audio playback.

Long Battery Life: Stay connected without interruption — the built-in 320mAh battery provides up to 9 hours of continuous transmission time and up to 12 hours in receiver mode, making it ideal for long drives, calls, or movie nights.
Fast Charging via Type-C: The device supports Type-C fast charging, which fully powers up your device within 2 to 3 hours, ensuring you're always ready when needed.
Universal Audio Connectivity: Features an AUX input for easy integration with a wide range of audio devices, from car stereos to home speaker systems.
Built-in Microphone (RX Mode): Enjoy hands-free calls while driving or working with the built-in microphone feature, available in Receiver (RX) mode.
LED Indicator Light: An intuitive LED indicator provides visual confirmation of device status and pairing progress, enhancing user control and ease of use.
Compact, Portable with Plug and Play: Sleek, lightweight and driverless. Just slip it into your pocket and connect instantly to your TV, car stereo or speaker system.
Lossless Audio Experience: Engineered for clarity, the device supports high-quality audio transmission and reception, ensuring crisp, distortion-free playback for music, calls, or podcasts.
3-Year Manufacturer Warranty: Backed by Honeywell's trusted quality, this product comes with a 3-year manufacturer warranty — ensuring durability, peace of mind, and hassle-free support.
